description: This file manages storing, retrieving, and clearing a session-based authentication token in the browser's sessionStorage, providing an interface for client-side token management.

methods.name: export function getStoredToken(): string | null { getStoredToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored auth token from sessionStorage, or returns null if not present or if not running in a browser environment.

methods.name: export function setStoredToken(token: string): void { setStoredToken
methods.description: Stores the provided auth token in sessionStorage, or does nothing if not running in a browser environment.

methods.name: export function clearStoredToken(): void { clearStoredToken
methods.description: Removes the stored auth token from sessionStorage, or does nothing if not running in a browser environment.
